title: Whatever и whoever без точного выбора
description: Whatever и whoever без точного выбора: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Использовать whatever для любого подходящего предмета
Использовать whoever для любого подходящего человека
notes: Take whatever you need — возьми всё, что тебе нужно, без точного перечисления.
Whoever относится к человеку: Whoever arrives first can collect the key. Это не вопросительное предложение.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Что означало take whatever they needed?

public_payload.passage: The workshop leader placed spare materials on a table and told groups to take whatever they needed for their own designs. This was permission to choose relevant materials, not an instruction to take the whole supply. Whoever finished the first stage could help another group, provided that their own tools had been put away safely. Several participants welcomed the flexibility, while the leader reminded them that an open choice still operated within the stated purpose and safety rules.

options.label: Choose materials relevant to their designs.
Take the entire supply regardless of need.

exercises.editorial_answer: Choose materials relevant to their designs.
exercises.explanation: Need и контекст собственных проектов ограничивают цель выбора.
